assigned_to: any (Gemini first; Grok and Muse take rooms nobody has claimed)
why: Joseph, 2026-11-08: the third spaces are super high quality photographs made by you, with the app layering live depth, light, particles and sound over them, never 3D worlds drawn in code. Nine themes have their room already (Gemini's sets, 9/10). This request covers the other 41 themes, then remakes the first nine at a larger size: the first sets were 1376x768, which looks soft on a phone held upright (the photo is stretched about 3 times to fill the screen's height).
global_style: Real photography: full-frame camera, 24 mm lens at eye height (about 1.6 m; close-ups and models at table height), level horizon, natural perspective, deep shadows that still hold detail, true reflections, physically accurate materials, practical light only, rich natural colour, fine film grain, tack sharp from front to back. It reads as a photograph in an architecture or interiors magazine, never as a video game, a 3D render or an illustration. Make it as good as the best photograph you can make: Joseph walks into these rooms, so quality comes before speed.
room_rule: This is a place to be in, seen from where a visitor stands: empty of people and of coins. The light sources stay inside the frame (the app makes them glow and flicker live), the air in the middle third stays open (the app adds live dust, rain, leaves and haze there), and nothing important sits within 8 % of the edges.
negative: no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or signs with words; no people, faces, statues with faces or hands; no coins; no watermark or frame; no 3D-render plastic look; no oversaturation or HDR halos; no fisheye or tilted horizon; no blur except natural depth of field
deliverable_spec: Five files per room, all the same size and lined up pixel for pixel: room_{id}_wide.png (the photo), room_{id}_depth.png, room_{id}_lights.png, room_{id}_front.png (the foreground object on flat green), room_{id}_back.png (the photo with the foreground object removed). Size: the largest your tool offers; pick 4K (or 2K) if it lets you choose. If the edits come back smaller than the wide photo, keep them as they come and say the sizes in the DONE line. PNG, never upscaled with another tool, never cropped. No upright version this time: the app pans across the wide photo on a phone.
instructions: Follow 'ART_START_HERE (any AI: images + video)'. Several AIs can share this request, one room at a time: before a room, look in the output folder for a claim file for it; if there is none (or it is older than 24 h with no files), save 'artreq_20261108-1500_room-layers-all.CLAIMED-{you}-{theme_id}.txt' and do that room. Gemini starts at the top of the list; Grok and Muse start from the bottom of the priority-1 list and work upward. For each room: (1) make room_{id}_wide.png from the room's prompt + the room_rule + the global_style sentence, 16:9, at the size above; look at it and remake it (at most 3 tries) if it has letters, a person, a face, a coin, a crooked horizon, or looks like a render or a painting. (2) Then work FROM THAT SAME IMAGE with image editing, one edit per step, giving the image back to yourself each time, so every file lines up: the four edit prompts are in 'edits': fill in {id} with the room's theme_id and {foreground} with its foreground. Save every file to 'Titan Reliquary/art-incoming (AI images + video)/artreq_20261108-1500_room-layers-all/' with the exact names. After each room, add one line per file to 'artreq_20261108-1500_room-layers-all.DONE-{you}.txt' (file name, ok or skipped: reason, size in pixels, model name, date). Priority 1 = the 41 new rooms; priority 2 = the first nine remade, only if your tool makes images larger than 1376 px wide. Stop at the first failure or quota warning and say in your DONE file how far you got; the next run continues. Save files in Drive only: Joseph cannot see your chat replies and must never be asked to copy anything.

edits.depth: Using this image, make its depth map: the same framing and the same size, greyscale only, white for what is nearest the camera, black for the farthest, smooth gradients, sharp edges where objects end, no text and nothing else. Save as room_{id}_depth.png.
edits.lights: Using this image, make a light mask: the same framing and the same size, pure black everywhere except the light sources and the brightest light they throw (windows, sun and moonbeams, lamps, flames, screens, glowing liquid, neon), which are white with soft edges. Save as room_{id}_lights.png.
edits.front: Using this image, keep only {foreground} exactly where it is and replace everything else with pure flat green #00FF00. Save as room_{id}_front.png.
edits.back: Using this image, remove {foreground} and fill that area naturally with what would be behind it, changing nothing else. Save as room_{id}_back.png.

rooms.prompt: Night photograph inside a torch-lit Mesoamerican stone temple chamber: on the far wall a great disc of hammered gold carved in concentric calendar rings and inlaid with green jadeite glows in the firelight; below it a still pool of polished black volcanic glass mirrors the disc. Carved basalt walls, two bronze braziers burning low on either side.
rooms.foreground: the carved basalt pillar with a jade-inlaid serpent head close to the camera on the right
